posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
Apoaste comes to Megalopolis for some post-Christmas sales and finds Legacy, Sky-Scraper, Santa Guise, Setback and Prime Wardens Haka waiting for him. Violence ensues.

Very simple and straightforward. Legacy starts with Inspiring Presence and from there things only get painful for the Fallen Angel.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: That was fun, Setback doing 8 or 9 damage a hit with Uh, Yeah I'm That Guy on Legacy. My finale was crazy: with a second Apocalypse in play and no one able to play cards, Guise unwrapped his gifts, got the Shooty Barbarian combo, and was able to do exactly enough damage to take out Apostate after he pulled two Pugilists out of the trash. Close, because it was right before Apocalypse would have taken everyone's stuff out.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Super punchy!

 

At one point, Apostate had the Periapt,Effigy, Runes, and Orb come out all in the same Profane Summons, but thankfully, Santa Guise decided to open his own presents, revealing (among a couple of other things) XTREEEEEEME! and a Blatant Reference.

 

How'dya like consistent, Legacy-buffed, irreducible, un-redirectable damage, you meddlesome relics?  Santa Guise says, "Merry Christmas -- Eat Lead!"

 

Fun one.

posts.name: deddragon
posts.cooked: Skyscraper was the VIP for me. She took all the hits with 2 Thorathian Monoliths, including from her own power and one seriously boosted Rampage. She and Haka took out all the Relics and Demons (some twice) so Apostate never got to flip. Meanwhile, Setback and Guise nailed the big guy at every turn. Legacy buffed as he does, and took most of the grief from not being able to occasionally draw or use powers or play cards.
